subject: Residency / Retention / Erasure: artifact queue & timeline
messages:
From: Atlas Bank <security@atlasbank.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: J. Smith <j.smith@atlasbank.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Artifact request: residency + deletion scenarios for SOC 2 assessment

Hi Hannah / Karthik,

Thanks for the walk-through last week. As we prepare for the SOC 2 evidence collection next month, our auditor has asked for representative artifacts that show how Redwood handles tenant data across three scenarios:

- cross-region replication and an explicit request to delete a tenant;
- TTL-driven archival and subsequent permanent deletion after retention; and
- a customer-requested export + erasure combo (copy-out then delete).

Can you provide sample artifacts (logs, retention mapping extract, erasure job run summaries) and a suggested timeline for delivering these? We need high-level descriptions for each artifact plus one concrete sample each.

Please flag any PII in attachments and share redaction guidance if needed.

Best,
Jake Smith
Senior InfoSec, Atlas Bank
security@atlasbank.com

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Atlas Bank <security@atlasbank.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Artifact request: residency + deletion scenarios for SOC 2 assessment

Jake — thanks, we can do this. High-level plan and what we'll attach below.

Plan (deliver by Dec 5 EOD PT):
- Package A: "Replication + Tenant Erasure" — retention mapping extract (CSV), erasure-run summary (JSON log snippet), and a redacted storage path audit trail.
- Package B: "TTL archival -> permanent delete" — archival job ledger excerpt, object tombstone records, and final deletion confirmation (storage GC log).
- Package C: "Export then Erase" — Data export job manifest (anonymized), delivery confirmation, and subsequent erasure job record.

Attachments we'll share: redwood-erasure-flow.pdf (diagram + step-by-step), retention-mapping-snapshot.csv (sample mapping), soc2-checklist-artifacts.xlsx (index mapping artifacts to control statements).

Notes / caveats:
- We will redact tenant IDs to masked IDs in the samples. If you need raw tenant IDs for traceability in your audit, we can discuss an NDA-limited transfer.
- Karthik will pull the erasure-run snippets; Naomi, tagging you for any legal/privacy constraints.

Action: Karthik, can you confirm the extraction process and whether we need additional runtime logs for any of the packages?

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Manager, Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference
(attachment: redwood-erasure-flow.pdf (PDF, 142KB))

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Atlas Bank <security@atlasbank.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Dec 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Artifact request: residency + deletion scenarios for SOC 2 assessment

Hannah / Jake — quick status update. Extraction notes: 

- Replication + Tenant Erasure: we can pull a retention-mapping-snapshot.csv (columns: tenant_masked_id, primary_region, replica_regions, retention_ttl_days, last_modified). Erasure-run summary will be a 3-entry log snippet (started, completed, verification checks) — I'll redact absolute storage paths.
- TTL archival flow: archival ledger entries are available back to 90 days. GC deletion confirmation is logged in the storage job system; I'll include truncated job IDs.
- Export + Erase: export manifests include filenames and checksums. For audit we will replace filenames with anonymized tokens.

Estimated ETA: packages ready for internal review by Dec 4 5pm PT; final package to Atlas by Dec 5 5pm PT. If Atlas needs anything earlier (e.g., raw logs), flag it and we will open a secure transfer channel.

(attachment: retention-mapping-snapshot.csv (CSV, 24KB))

Subject: Re: Artifact request: residency + deletion scenarios for SOC 2 assessment

Thanks for the quick turn-around — the plan looks good. A couple of follow-ups from the auditor: 

1) For the Replication + Tenant Erasure package, they want one concrete timeline showing the erase request -> background job scheduling -> final verification steps (timestamps). Can you include a redacted timeline report for a single test tenant?

2) For TTL archival, they asked whether archived objects are held in a patient-deletion queue (i.e., quarantined for manual review) or automatically garbage-collected. A short note on any manual review gates would be helpful.

3) Please attach the SOC 2 mapping table (control ID -> artifact file) as a separate sheet in the checklist spreadsheet.

If you can provide the three sample packages by EOD PT today, we can slot them into the auditor's binder for the readiness review on Monday.

Best,
Jake
